items.title: Cauvery basin faces severe water stress due to weak monsoon
items.whyInNews: On 22 August 2026 a weak southwest monsoon has left farmers in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu with critically low water levels in the Cauvery River, intensifying interstate disputes over water allocation.

The water stress has revived tensions under the Cauvery Water Dispute Tribunal, which last ordered a release of 30 cubic metres per second to Tamil Nadu in 2023.

items.title: GCL chairperson announces Bengaluru edition of the Global Cricket League to commence in October 2026
items.whyInNews: On 22 August 2026 the chairperson of the Global Cricket League, Mr. Arvind Kumar, declared that the Bengaluru edition of the league will start on 5 October 2026 at the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru, Karnataka, expecting high local participation.
items.summary: GCL chairperson Arvind Kumar announced on 22 August 2026 that the Bengaluru edition of the Global Cricket League will begin on 5 October 2026 at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru, Karnataka. The statement highlighted expectations of strong fan turnout and involvement of regional teams. The league is part of the GCL's expansion plan to host editions in major Indian metros by 2027.
keyPoints: Arvind Kumar, chairperson of Global Cricket League, announced Bengaluru edition
The tournament will start on 5 October 2026 at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru, Karnataka
The announcement was made on 22 August 2026
GCL aims to host editions in five Indian metros by 2027
importantPoints: Global Cricket League (GCL) was founded in 2019, headquarters in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
The launch follows the International Cricket Council's (ICC) Regulation 2.3 (2025) on franchise league approvals
This is the first time the GCL will be held in Bengaluru, expanding beyond its initial venues of Dubai and Singapore
India currently ranks 2nd in the ICC T20I Team Rankings 2026 out of 80 nations
The league provides a platform for Indian domestic talent to gain exposure ahead of the 2026 Asian Games
